title: A Killer Story
description:
S01 E03 — A Dangerous Notion
The state tries Chandler for a third time after the retrial ends in a hung jury. Chandler dismisses her legal team and chooses to represent herself. Later, a verdict brings finality to the case.

title: Taken 2
description: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

title: When You Clean a Stranger's Home
description: Abby, a first-generation high school student, describes what she and her mom have learned about people when cleaning their homes.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E04 — The Weenie
Hal and John press forward with their investigation into Manhunter's true identity. The Guardians grow restless in their efforts to replace Hal.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E05 — Lights Out
Rushville mobilizes to confront an escalating threat; later, Hal risks everything to eliminate the Manhunter when John is cornered into an impossible choice.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E06 — Bad Optics
Following fresh recruit John Stewart and Green Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery.

title: Lanterns
description:
S01 E07 — The Jordan Boys' Legacy
Finding themselves on another planet, Hal and John must put aside their fractured past to solve a murder; along their journey, both men are forced to confront the ghosts of their pasts and the ways their childhoods shaped who they are today.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E01 — The Hidden Hand
On Wallach IX, young Valya Harkonnen promises Mother Superior Raquella that she'll protect the Sisterhood by putting one of their own on the Imperial Throne; thirty years later, Valya faces a threat to her long-awaited plan.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E02 — Two Wolves
Two Harkonnen sisters combat forces that threaten the future of humankind and establish the fabled sect that will be known as the Bene Gesserit.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E03 — Sisterhood Above All
Following a tragedy, young Tula worries about being accepted despite her family name; a skeptical Valya struggles with the decision to take the Sisterhood vow; years later, Valya receives a message that confirms her suspicions.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E04 — Twice Born
Tula tries to understand the origins of the nightmare that affects all acolytes of the sisterhood; as Tula attempts to understand the acolytes' shared dream, Valya sets her plan in motion to redeem House Harkonnen ahead of the Landsraad.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E05 — In Blood, Truth
As Corrino names a new Bashar, a Sister with deep connections to the Emperor arrives on Salusa Secundus; after receiving a tip, Desmond goes on a warpath to root out the insurgents; Tula tries to keep her secret project from being discovered.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E06 — The High-Handed Enemy
As Tula contends with the reveal of Desmond's true identity, the acolytes uncover a devastating long-held secret about the Sisterhood.

title: The Night Of

While attorney John Stone counsels Naz, lead detective Dennis Box investigates the crime.

title: The Night Of
description:
S01 E03 — Part 3: A Dark Crate
As he awaits his formal arraignment at Rikers Island, Naz realizes that his survival, or perhaps his demise, rests in the hands of a particular inmate.

title: The Night Of
description:
S01 E04 — Part 4: The Art of War
Attorney John Stone works to uncover information about the crime.

title: The Night Of
description:
S01 E05 — Part 5: The Season of the Witch
Box reconstructs Naz's whereabouts on the night of the murder.

title: The Night Of
description:

Prosecutor Helen Weiss prepares for the upcoming trial; Naz's alliance with Freddy continues to grow.

title: The Night Of
description:

Naz's trial moves to the defense phase.

title: The Night Of
description:

Stone is thrust into the spotlight as a controversy involving the defense emerges.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E01 — Never the New
In 1882, Marian arrives at the home of her "old money" aunts Agnes and Ada, whose new neighbors vie to break into New York high society.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E02 — Money Isn't Everything
Marian receives a visit from Tom Raikes, whose legal advice Peggy seeks; the Russells take center stage at a charity bazaar.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E03 — Face the Music
An unfortunate development finds George's new rail station under threat; Marian continues to see Mr. Raikes despite Agnes' warnings.

title: The Gilded Age
description:

In the aftermath of a tragedy, George agrees to help Bertha; a visit has a lasting impact on the staff of Russell house.

title: The Gilded Age
description:

Bertha, Marian, Aurora, and Peggy make an overnight trip to see Clara Barton speak; Gladys' desired beau is invited to dinner.

title: The Gilded Age
description:

As George fights to protect his public image, Agnes' status quo is disrupted; Armstrong intensifies her campaign against Peggy.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S01 E07 — Irresistible Change
As Edison's illuminating electricity demonstration sparks conversation, George prepares for a legal battle, and Bannister plots revenge.

title: The Gilded Age
description:

Peggy reveals the truth about her past; George's day in court arrives; Marian considers her romantic future.

title: The Gilded Age
description:

Marian's grand plan is threatened; Bertha and Mrs. Astor lock horns over Gladys' debut; Peggy is stunned.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E01 — You Don't Even Like Opera
Agnes shares news of her nephew Dashiell's imminent arrival in New York; Bertha decides to back the new Metropolitan Opera House.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E02 — Some Sort of Trick
George delivers a final decision to Oscar; Peggy is welcomed back into the Van Rhijn household by all but one; Marian meets a new match.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E03 — Head to Head
A surprise guest attends Bertha's fundraiser; Ada organizes a luncheon for Mr. Forte; Peggy presses Mr. Fortune about Tuskegee.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E04 — His Grace the Duke
Bertha angles for position with a visiting Duke; with Marian's help, Ada continues to see Mr. Forte; Peggy travels to Alabama.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E05 — Close Enough to Touch
After sharing her news, Ada questions moving ahead without Agnes' support; Peggy experiences the dangers of the South.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E06 — Warning Shots
As George heads to Pittsburgh to deal with the potential strike, Bertha learns that the Duke will return for the Metropolitan Opera's opening night; Bannister tries to retrieve an incriminating letter from the Russell house.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E07 — Wonders Never Cease
As New York celebrates a historic event, Bertha reconsiders her loyalty to the Met while Marian has doubts about her future.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S02 E08 — In Terms of Winning and Losing
The staff questions its future at Rhijn's house, just as Peggy questions her future at The New York Globe; Marian confesses her true feelings to Dashiell; the opera war reaches its climax.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E01 — Who Is in Charge Here?
George has ambitious plans to build a railway line between New York, Chicago and Los Angeles, but his plans are met with resistance; Bertha is busy preparing for the Duke's arrival.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E02 — What the Papers Say
Amid their domestic quibbles, Agnes and Ada welcome the Scotts into their home; Bertha and George disagree about Gladys's future.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E03 — El amor nunca es fácil
George negotiates with the Duke.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E04 — Marriage Is a Gamble
Bertha deals with unwanted rumors in the press and the surprise arrival of her sister Monica.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E05 — A Different World
Gladys adjusts to her changed circumstances; Larry runs into a familiar face; Peggy gets an opportunity from an old colleague.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E06 — If You Want to Cook an Omelette
Marian has doubts.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E07 — Ex-Communicated
Mrs Astor discusses the future of her Newport ball with Bertha; Larry receives disturbing news; Mrs Kirkland gets information about Peggy.

title: The Gilded Age
description:
S03 E08 — My Mind Is Made Up
Bertha finalizes the guest list for the ball and faces the consequences; Dr. Kirkland makes a decision.

title: Mare of Easttown
description:

Detective Mare Sheehan revives an unsolved missing person's case amid increased community pressure; Mare attends a celebration for her legendary high school basketball win and connects with Richard, a professor who's new in town.

title: Mare of Easttown
description:
S01 E02 — Fathers
Mare visits a grisly murder scene before informing the victim's enraged father; as a video from the night of the crime surfaces, Mare questions suspects in the case and gives an icy welcome to county Detective Colin Zabel, called in to assist.

title: Mare of Easttown
description:
S01 E03 — Enter Number Two
As Mare and Colin parse new physical evidence, phone records lead to an unlikely suspect; after lashing out at Helen about a possible custody fight over Drew, Mare receives some unprompted advice from Richard on how to move forward with Carrie.

title: Mare of Easttown
description:
S01 E04 — Poor Sisyphus
With Mare forced to take a backseat on the case, Colin presses a local priest about the vague circumstances that prompted his transfer to the parish; an anonymous call gives Dawn hope that Katie might still be alive.

title: Mare of Easttown
description:
S01 E05 — Illusions
In her mandated therapy, Mare opens up about her family's history with mental health; Lori tries to get to the bottom of her son's outburst at school; Mare meets with a semi-retired source to help find a possible connection to her three cases.

title: Mare of Easttown

With untold millions at risk, nuclear physicist Ulana Khomyuk makes a desperate attempt to reach Valery Legasov, a leading Soviet nuclear physicist, and warn him about the threat of a second explosion that could devastate the continent.

title: Chernobyl
description:
S01 E03 — Open Wide, O Earth
Lyudmilla Ignatenko, a Pripyat resident, ignores warnings about her firefighter husband's contamination; Valery Legasov lays out a decontamination plan, complete with human risks.

title: Chernobyl
description:
S01 E04 — The Happiness of All Mankind
Valery Legasov and Soviet Deputy Prime Minister Boris Shcherbina consider using lunar rovers to remove radioactive debris; Ulana Khomyuk faces government hurdles in determining the truth about the cause of the explosion.

title: Chernobyl

Valery Legasov, Boris Shcherbina and Ulana Khomyuk risk their lives and reputations to expose the truth about Chernobyl.
